scanner_adapters.build: strict cc execution in a bounded child with exit status and SHA-256 evidence
scanner_adapters.dependency: recursive bounded analysis of supported build/package manifests with content digest and file/byte counts
scanner_adapters.vulnerability: external grype/osv-scanner/trivy adapter selection; missing scanner returns unavailable and blocks the evidence gate

enforcement: cgroup v2 resource setup with required-path fail-closed behavior
seccomp allowlist with architecture check and deny-by-default action
trusted_launcher.diagnostic_resolution: Initial SIGSYS came from a glibc-based probe runtime outside the allowlist; a minimal x86-64 assembly probe using only write and exit was used for deterministic seccomp validation. The production filter remains deny-by-default.

conclusions: seccomp is attack-surface reduction, not a complete sandbox
architecture must be checked before syscall numbers
SECCOMP_RET_LOG is appropriate only for development diagnostics

non_claims: No claim of AGI, consciousness, self-awareness, retraining, or unlimited capability
No claim that vulnerability analysis passes when no supported scanner is installed
No claim that namespaces were fully created when the host/QEMU policy denies unshare; the launcher records the attempt and can require them fail-closed
